title: Cycle-Rank-Two Block Is a Theta Graph
statement:
Let \(B\) be a finite simple 2-connected graph with cyclomatic number
\[
|E(B)|-|V(B)|+1=2.
\]
Then exactly two vertices of \(B\) have degree three, every other
vertex has degree two, and \(B\) is the union of three internally
vertex-disjoint paths with the same two endpoints.

title: Exact Theta Boundary-Projection Theorem
statement:
Let a finite fiber-coherence CSP have a tree-absorbed 2-connected
incidence block that is a theta graph with branch nodes \(s,t\) and
internally disjoint paths \(P_1,P_2,P_3\). Give a variable branch node
its surviving value domain and a constraint branch node its surviving
allowed-tuple domain. For each path let
\[
R_i\subseteq \Omega_s\times\Omega_t
\]
be the pairs of boundary states extendable through that path and all
branches absorbed into it. Then the block has a coherent section if
and only if
\[
R_1\cap R_2\cap R_3\ne\varnothing.
\]

title: Polynomial-Time Theta Coherence and Certificates
statement:
Finite fiber coherence on a tree-absorbed theta incidence block is
decidable in polynomial time in the explicit domain and relation tables.
An incoherence certificate consists of the three computed path relations
and a certificate that their intersection is empty.

title: Unit-Slack Theorem for Minimal Incoherent Cores
statement:
Let \(\mathcal C=\{C_1,\dots,C_m\}\) be an inclusion-minimal finite
incoherent CSP. For every \(j\), the PG21 extension slack of \(C_j\)
relative to \(\mathcal C-\{C_j\}\) is exactly one. Moreover, deleting
any old constraint \(C_i\), \(i\ne j\), is a valid one-constraint repair.
Consequently scalar positive extension slack cannot distinguish minimal
incoherent core mechanisms, and a zero-slack final incoherence step is
impossible.

title: One-Step Repair Matrix Collapses to the Deletion Spectrum
statement:
In the setting of TH04, for \(i\ne j\), let \(M_{ij}\) be the number of
assignments satisfying \(C_j\) and every constraint other than \(C_i\).
Then
\[
M_{ij}=|\operatorname{Sol}(\mathcal C-\{C_i\})|.
\]
Thus the complete one-step repair matrix contains no information beyond
the deletion-solution spectrum from PG19.

title: Complete Cycle-Rank-Two Obstruction Classification
Intrinsic Theta Collision Criterion
statement:
A rank-two theta block is individually coherent on each of its three
cycles but globally incoherent if and only if
\[
R_1\cap R_2,\ R_1\cap R_3,\ R_2\cap R_3
\quad\text{are all nonempty, while}\quad
R_1\cap R_2\cap R_3=\varnothing.
\]

title: Four-State Theta Relation Census
statement:
For ordered triples \((R_1,R_2,R_3)\) of relations viewed as subsets of
a four-element boundary-pair state space, exhaustive enumeration gives:
\[
721\text{ path-empty triples},\quad
1548\text{ pair-obstructed triples},\quad
132\text{ intrinsic theta collisions},\quad
1695\text{ coherent triples}.
\]

title: K4-Free Permutation Strip Realization
statement:
Let \(D\) be finite, let \(\ell\ge4\), and let
\(\alpha_0,\dots,\alpha_{\ell-1}\in S_D\). There is a finite
\(K_4\)-free stable-partition graph whose realized triangle-type CSP is
an open strip of \(\ell\) constraints and whose boundary transfer is
\[
\alpha_{\ell-1}\circ\cdots\circ\alpha_0.
\]
Both boundary fibers may be prescribed as identity matchings.

title: K4-Free Multi-Strip Theta Realization
statement:
Let \(\pi_1,\dots,\pi_r\in S_D\), with \(r\ge2\). There is a finite
\(K_4\)-free stable-partition graph consisting of \(r\) internally
disjoint permutation strips sharing exactly their two boundary fibers.
Its tree-absorbed incidence core is the union of \(r\) internally
disjoint paths between two branch variables and has cycle rank \(r-1\).

title: Permutation Multi-Theta Coherence Theorem
statement:
In TH10, coherent sections are in bijection with values \(a\in D\) for
which
\[
\pi_1(a)=\pi_2(a)=\cdots=\pi_r(a).
\]
Thus the number of coherent sections equals the size of this common
agreement set.

title: Domain Four Is Minimal for an Intrinsic Three-Path Permutation Collision
statement:
Three permutations can agree pairwise somewhere while having no point of
common agreement only on domains of size at least four. Domain four is
sufficient.

title: First Intrinsic 2-Connected Rank-Two K4-Free Core
statement:
There is a finite \(K_4\)-free fiber-coherence system whose
tree-absorbed incidence block is 2-connected of cycle rank two, each of
its three cycle subsystems is coherent, every relation is a bijection and
every value is locally supported, but the full system is incoherent.
It may be realized on a four-element fiber domain.

title: Constraint-Minimality of Proper-Agreement Multi-Thetas
statement:
In a permutation multi-theta, suppose the full permutation family has no
common agreement point but every proper subfamily does. Then the complete
fiber CSP is inclusion-minimal incoherent at the constraint level.

title: Arbitrarily High-Rank Minimal Intrinsic Multi-Thetas
statement:
For every \(r\ge3\), there is a finite \(K_4\)-free, inclusion-minimal
incoherent permutation multi-theta whose tree-absorbed incidence core is
2-connected of cycle rank \(r-1\), every proper path subfamily is
coherent, and every relation is a bijection.

title: No Helly Bound in the 2-Connected Pure-Permutation Regime
statement:
No finite local-subsystem bound decides coherence even for finite
\(K_4\)-free systems whose tree-absorbed incidence core is 2-connected
and whose every constraint relation is a bijection.

title: One-Deletion Spectrum of a Minimal Permutation Multi-Theta
statement:
Consider an inclusion-minimal permutation multi-theta on domain size
\(d\), with \(\ell\) triangle constraints per strip. For path \(j\), let
\[
A_{-j}=\{a:\pi_k(a)\text{ is independent of }k\ne j\}.
\]
Deleting any one constraint from strip \(j\) leaves exactly
\[
d\,|A_{-j}|
\]
coherent sections. Consequently the deletion spectrum is constant along
each strip and
\[
N_1=\ell d\sum_j |A_{-j}|.
\]

title: Exact Ground State of the Domain-Four Theta Core
statement:
Realize the TH13 domain-four example with three strips of four constraints
each. The resulting 12-constraint CSP has zero coherent sections. Every
one-constraint deletion has exactly four coherent sections, so
\[
N_1=48.
\]

title: Finite-Fiber #595 Rank-Two Close Theorem
statement:
In the finite-obstruction branch of a stable finite-fiber compression of
a hypothetical Erdős #595 witness, every inclusion-minimal 2-connected
incidence block of cycle rank two is completely classified by TH06.
Therefore every still-unclassified minimal 2-connected block has cycle
rank at least three.

title: Page-Free Rank-Two Close
statement:
The page-free unary-homogeneous witness produced by HG21 has the same
rank-two close: every finite minimal obstruction is either cactus,
theta-classified, or contains a 2-connected incidence block of cycle
rank at least three; otherwise the full coherent-compression branch holds.

title: Cycle-Rank-Three Ear-Interaction Census Target
statement:
Enumerate inclusion-minimal finite \(K_4\)-free fiber CSPs whose first
unclassified 2-connected incidence block has cycle rank three. Use an
ear decomposition consisting of a theta block plus one added ear. Record
the theta path relations, the new ear relation, every pair/triple
intersection, the second-order deletion spectrum, and whether
incoherence is already visible in a proper rank-two subblock.
Classify the first core intrinsic to all four paths/ears.

title: Second-Order Deletion Profile Target
statement:
Because scalar extension slack and the one-step repair matrix collapse on
minimal cores, compute the pair-deletion profile
\[
D_{ij}=|\operatorname{Sol}(\mathcal C-\{C_i,C_j\})|
\]
together with the locations of the deleted constraints in the incidence
block. Determine whether this profile separates support, monodromy,
theta-collision, and first rank-three intrinsic cores.
